# Pollard contact-map scoring sources

`scoring.py` and `hicrep.py` are preserved without modification from
[pollardlab/contact_map_scoring](https://github.com/pollardlab/contact_map_scoring),
recorded upstream commit `d6f1997`. The files retain their original author and
reference information. XChroma wrappers are in `xbench/metrics/`.

The upstream repository and retained source snapshot do not provide a LICENSE
file. These files are not assigned an XChroma license; redistribution permission
must be resolved before a public software release.
